cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say the Scary Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before we open the landlord's letter, tell me the worst thing it could mean for our shop. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I know the number. I need you to say the thing I'm counting towards.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And what would that make me, after Dad trusted me with it? Say that bit first too.

mechanism: A directs opening a threatening shop letter but negotiates who speaks and reads so B names the feared loss and personal failure first.
confusable: Unlike asking B for a practical prediction alone, A also needs the shame named first; authority adapts the reading procedure to keep B involved.
comparison: An inherited business and unopened letter differ from a mutual sporting partnership before performance.
seedUse: Use D104-a letter, missed rent and inherited shop; S02-a procedural concession supplies the manner of recruiting B.
